AccountDetailView.description: An account with its live state on every network the market runs on for this key.

address.description: The wallet, EIP-55. The same on every network.

displayName.description: The name people see on a quote when this account is the merchant. Required before it can publish an offer.

merchantStatus.description: Whether its offers are matched. You set ACTIVE or PAUSED; SUSPENDED is set by the platform and only the platform lifts it.

networks.description: One entry per network; a network whose node cannot be read right now is left out.

AccountNetworkView.description: An account on one network, read live from the contract.

operators.description: Operators the market saw this account grant on this network, with their permission bits (1 open, 2 release, 4 trade, 8 withdraw). A grant of 0 is a revocation and is left out.

AccountView.description: A wallet this organization proved it holds, on the key’s tier: what it trades, charges and pays out from.

address.description: The wallet, EIP-55. The same on every network.

displayName.description: The name people see on a quote when this account is the merchant. Required before it can publish an offer.

merchantStatus.description: Whether its offers are matched. You set ACTIVE or PAUSED; SUSPENDED is set by the platform and only the platform lifts it.

Activate.description: Create your account and open a token’s trustline, sponsored.

AdminMerchantDto.description: A merchant status only the platform sets.

merchantStatus.description: SUSPENDED stops the merchant from being matched.

arbiter.description: The arbiter the contract names now: the wallet that must sign.

AdminResolutionDto.description: How the arbiter splits a disputed order.

bondToSeller.description: Base units of the buyer's bond that go to the seller; the rest goes back to the buyer.

toBuyer.description: Base units of the order's amount that go to the buyer (fees are taken from it); the rest goes back to the seller.

ApiKey.description: An API key; the secret itself is shown only once.

prefix.description: The first characters, for recognising it.

AppAccountState.description: Whether the account exists on the network.

AppActivation.description: The sponsored activation to sign, if any.

transaction.description: Null when there is nothing to do. When the account is missing its source is the sponsor (a missing account has no sequence number); the API adds the sponsor’s signature at submit.

nextCursor.description: Pass it as `cursor` for the next page.

AppActivityItem.description: One line of your activity: an order (`order`) or a transfer (`transfer`).

xlm.description: The whole lumen balance, stroops, reserves included (fees are sponsored: usually 0). What can be sent is the `XLM` entry of `tokens`, when the market lists it.

AppCharge.description: A charge as its payer sees it.

payWithBalance.description: Null when the charge is not open or no quote prices it now.

rails.description: Rails the local-money checkout offers now.

AppChargePayment.description: A charge paid from a wallet’s balance.

AppCreatedChargePayment.description: A charge payment and the transaction to sign.

transaction.description: The token transfer to the charge’s receiving account; it expires with the price.

AppCreatedTransfer.description: A transfer and the transaction to sign.

transaction.description: A classic `payment` to a G or M recipient, a SAC `transfer` to a C recipient; the note is its text memo. The native lumen (`XLM`) always moves through its SAC `transfer` (the note then stays off-chain).

AppOrder.description: An order from your quote. A purchase (BUY) needs `payer`; a sale (SELL) needs `beneficiary`; a QR payment (`kind: QR_PAY`) needs the same `qr` its quote was made for.

kind.description: Optional; when given it must be the quote’s kind.

qr.description: A QR payment: the scanned QR, exactly as quoted.

quoteId.description: A quote of yours, not expired. One order per quote.

AppPayWithBalance.description: What paying a charge from your balance costs now.

amount.description: Base units: what the business would have received, at the current best quote.

expiresAt.description: The price holds until then (60 s).

recipient.description: The account (G) or contract (C) the payment goes to.

AppQuote.description: What the signed-in wallet wants to do. A trade: `side`, `network`, `token`, `currency`, `rail` and one of `fiatAmount` or `tokenAmount`. A QR payment: `kind: QR_PAY`, `network`, `token`, `qr` and, when the QR carries no amount, `fiatAmount` (the currency and rail come from the QR).

fiatAmount.description: Local money. A trade: what the person pays (BUY) or receives (SELL). A QR payment: what the shop gets, required when the QR carries no amount and equal to it when it does.

kind.description: Omitted: the trade `side` says it. `QR_PAY`: pay a scanned merchant QR.

qr.description: A QR payment: the scanned merchant QR exactly as read (Peru’s interoperable QR of Yape, Plin and the banks, Brazil’s PIX, or Argentina’s interoperable QR). Its CRC must check. A static QR carries no amount: give `fiatAmount`.

side.description: A trade: BUY receives tokens and pays local money; SELL sends tokens and receives local money. Required unless `kind` is `QR_PAY`.

tokenAmount.description: A trade only: the token amount the order locks, base units.

AppTokenBalance.description: One token the market lists, as the account holds it.

amount.description: Base units (7 decimals); 0 without a trustline. For the native lumen (`XLM`): the SPENDABLE lumens, the balance less the reserves the account pays itself (sponsored ones excluded) and its selling liabilities.

authorized.description: Whether the issuer authorised that trustline. Always true for the native lumen.

trustline.description: Whether the account has a trustline to it. Always true for the native lumen, which needs none.

AppTransaction.description: An action your own wallet signs on your order.

action.description: Usually `release` (a sale or QR payment you were paid for), `dispute` or `cancel`; `open` is a pending sale or QR payment’s `open_with_deposit`, simulated now (ask for it right before signing: one simulated earlier can go stale when another order takes the order id it names). Refused when your wallet may not do it now.

fromHandle.description: Null for a payment from outside the app, or a sender without a handle.

to.description: As sent to: a G, M or C address.

AuthChallenge.description: A SEP-10 challenge: a transaction the account signs (it is never submitted). The SEP-10 response shape.

network_passphrase.description: The network passphrase the challenge is signed for.

transaction.description: The challenge transaction envelope, base64 XDR.

BalanceView.description: A balance an account holds in the contract.

amount.description: Free balance in base units: what new orders can lock and what can be withdrawn.

locked.description: Base units locked in live orders: those this account sells in, plus the bonds it locked accepting as a buyer. Derived from this service’s order records (an order opened outside this API is not counted); the free balance above is read from the contract.

BeneficiaryDto.description: Where the merchant pays the local money on a sale or a payout (to yourself or to someone else): a holder, the rail’s account details and, where the rail’s transfer needs it, the holder’s ID. The ID (`document` and the rail’s ID fields, such as `cuit` or `documentType`/`documentNumber`) is optional on every rail whose `beneficiaryIdRequired` is false (`GET /v1/market`): the holder’s bank already identified them. Chile (`rut`) and Colombia need it. Given, it is checked as always.

details.description: The rail’s fields, checked like a payment method’s.

document.description: The holder’s ID number. Required only on rails whose `beneficiaryIdRequired` is true (Chile, Colombia).

BeneficiaryView.description: Where the merchant pays the local money on a sale or a payout, shown to that merchant while it is live.

document.description: The holder’s ID number; null where the rail’s transfer does not need it and none was given.

BuildTransactionDto.description: A transaction to build for a wallet: what to do, from which wallet, with which arguments. See each action’s arguments in the route’s description.

from.description: The wallet that signs: one of your account ids, or, for an action on a sale, the seller’s address on that order.

ChallengeView.description: A registration challenge: a SEP-10-shaped transaction the account signs (it is never submitted). Besides the single-use nonce and `web_auth_domain`, its `organization` entry names your organization and tier, so it registers nothing else. Sign it once, before `expiresAt`.

transaction.description: The challenge transaction envelope, base64 XDR.

ChargeView.description: A charge in local money your customer pays on the hosted page: the tokens are delivered to `recipientAddress`, one of your registered wallets.

multiUse.description: Whether several payers may pay it; otherwise one order at a time, and it closes when paid.

payeeName.description: Who the payer sees it is paying.

url.description: The payer’s page. Share it, or show it as a QR.

CheckoutChargeView.description: A charge as its payer sees it: the amount, what it is for and the rails merchants take for it right now. Nothing about who created it.

merchantName.description: Who the payer is paying: the name the charge’s creator chose (`payeeName`).

rails.description: Rails a merchant offers for this currency, network and token now.

CheckoutCreatedOrderView.description: The payer’s new order, and the token that reads it and reports the payment. The token is shown once and never stored here (only its SHA-256): keep it in the page.

merchantName.description: The merchant the payer transfers to (it fills the order), not the charge’s payee.

payerToken.description: Send it as `X-Payer-Token` on the order’s routes.

paymentDetails.description: Where to transfer, while the order is live.

settleDeadline.description: When the settle window of a paid order closes: after it anyone may release the order, and the seller’s side can no longer dispute it. Null without a settle window, or before the order is paid.

CheckoutOrderView.description: A charge’s order as its payer sees it: how much to send, where, until when, and how it stands.

merchantName.description: The merchant the payer transfers to (it fills the order), not the charge’s payee.

paymentDetails.description: Where to transfer, while the order is live.

settleDeadline.description: When the settle window of a paid order closes: after it anyone may release the order, and the seller’s side can no longer dispute it. Null without a settle window, or before the order is paid.

CheckoutPayerDto.description: Who pays a charge: the merchant checks the transfer comes from this person.

tier.description: `live` keys (`pk_live_`) act on mainnet; `test` keys (`pk_test_`) on test networks.

CreateChallengeDto.description: The account a registration challenge is for.

network.description: The network whose ledger has the account’s signers; default: the tier’s only network.

CreateChargeDto.description: A charge in local money: the payer pays it on the hosted page and the tokens go to `recipient`.

expiresAt.description: Default: 24 hours from now. At most 30 days.

fiatAmount.description: Local money, up to the currency’s decimals.

multiUse.description: Let several payers pay it (each with one live order); otherwise it closes when paid.

payeeName.description: Who the payer is paying, as the payer page shows it (your business name). Never taken from your account.

recipient.description: One of your registered accounts, by id or by address: where the tokens go.

CreateCheckoutOrderDto.description: The payer starts paying a charge on one rail.

CreateOfferDto.description: A merchant’s standing price. Its bot refreshes `price` (a PATCH) before `priceTtlSeconds` runs out, or the offer stops matching.

accountId.description: The merchant account; it needs a `displayName`.

price.description: Local money per one token, up to 6 decimals.

priceTtlSeconds.description: Seconds the price stays matchable after each update.

rails.description: Rails of the currency you take. A SELL_TOKEN offer needs an active payment method on each.

side.description: SELL_TOKEN: you sell tokens from your balance in the contract (authorise the matcher for it). BUY_TOKEN: you buy tokens, accepting each order with a bond from your balance.

token.description: The token, by contract address or symbol (as `GET /v1/p2p/market` lists it).

CreateOrderDto.description: An order from a quote. A purchase (BUY) needs `recipient` and `payer`; a sale (SELL) needs `seller` and `beneficiary`.

kind.description: Optional; when given it must be the quote’s side.

quoteId.description: A quote of yours, not expired. One order per quote.

recipient.description: BUY: the wallet that receives the tokens.

seller.description: SELL: the wallet that holds the tokens and signs the two transactions. Refunds go back to it.

CreateOrderMessage.description: A message on an order’s chat: a text, an attachment (a transfer receipt), or both. At least one.

CreateOrderMessageAttachment.description: An image or a PDF (a transfer receipt), at most 2097152 bytes, in base64. Its leading bytes must be those of its type.

data.description: The file in standard base64 (padded, no line breaks).

name.description: Shown to the other side; never used as a path.

CreatePaymentMethodDto.description: Where an account receives local money on one rail. `details` takes the rail’s fields (`GET /v1/p2p/market` lists them) and is checked per rail, checksums included.

CreatePayoutDto.description: Payouts from your balance in the contract: each item is matched with a merchant and opened by the matcher on your balance.

accountId.description: The account paying out; optional when you have exactly one.

CreateQuoteDto.description: What a person wants to trade. Give `fiatAmount` (local money) or `tokenAmount` (base units), not both.

fiatAmount.description: BUY: what the person pays. SELL: what the person receives. Up to the currency’s decimals.

integratorAccountId.description: The account your fee is paid to; required with a fee when you have more than one account.

integratorFeeBps.description: Your own fee on this order, basis points of what the buyer receives, paid to `integratorAccountId` on-chain.

side.description: BUY: the person receives tokens and pays local money. SELL: the person sends tokens and receives local money.

token.description: By symbol, Stellar Asset Contract (C...) or CODE:ISSUER.

tokenAmount.description: The token amount the order locks, base units.

CreateTransfer.description: Send tokens to an address or an @handle.

note.description: At most 28 bytes; it becomes the transaction’s text memo.

to.description: A G (account), M (muxed account) or C (contract) address, or an @handle.

events.description: Events to receive; omitted or empty: every event.

url.description: https only; it must resolve to public addresses.

key.description: The secret: store it now, it is never shown again.

prefix.description: The first characters, for recognising it.

CreatedOrderView.description: A new order. A sale (`SELL`) or a QR payment (`QR_PAY`) also carries the one transaction the seller’s wallet signs: `open_with_deposit`, whose token pull into the market is authorised by the same signature (no approval).

bond.description: The merchant’s bond, base units (sales and payouts).

chat.description: The order’s chat with its merchant (`…/orders/{id}/messages`).

fiatAmount.description: The local money that changes hands.

kind.description: BUY: a person buys tokens from a merchant. SELL: a person sells tokens to a merchant. QR_PAY: a person pays a shop’s local-money QR through a merchant that buys their tokens. CHARGE: a payer pays one of your charges. PAYOUT: a merchant pays a beneficiary from your balance.

netAmount.description: Base units its buyer receives after fees.

onchainId.description: The order id in the contract, once indexed.

paidReference.description: The transfer reference reported with the payment.

paymentDetails.description: Where the person pays the local money: the merchant’s account, on a purchase or a charge while it is live. Null otherwise.

qr.description: A QR payment’s scanned QR, as its payer reads it (one order, not lists).

settleDeadline.description: When the settle window of a paid order closes: after it anyone may release the order, and the seller’s side can no longer dispute it. Null without a settle window, or before the order is paid.

transactions.description: Empty except on a sale or a QR payment still waiting for its signature.

secret.description: The signing secret, shown once. Verify `midpoint-signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<t>.<body>")>`.

CurrencyView.description: A local currency the market prices, with its rails.

decimals.description: Decimal places an amount in it may carry.

Error.description: Every error the API answers has this shape.

example: fiatAmount must be a positive decimal

FailedPayoutItemView.description: A payout item that never opened, and why.

index.description: Its position in the request, from 0.

MarketOverviewView.description: The P2P market for this API key: the networks it runs on, their contracts and tokens, the currencies and rails, the fee, the windows and the matcher to authorise.

available.description: Whether the market runs on at least one network for this key.

bondBps.description: The merchant's bond on a sale or a payout, basis points of the amount.

matcher.description: The matcher account: what a seller authorises with `set_matcher` so purchases and payouts open on its balance. It can open orders within the cap the seller sets and act for a buyer it opened an order for; it can never withdraw or release a seller's tokens.

maxIntegratorFeeBps.description: The most an integrator may charge per order, basis points.

tier.description: The tier the API key's environment selects (`prod`: public).

MatcherTermsView.description: What the account allows The matcher on one network.

autoSettle.description: Whether its orders may carry a settle window (silence after a payment releases them).

maxPerOrder.description: The largest order the matcher may open on this balance, base units; 0 = not authorised.

Member.description: A wallet that signs in for an organization.

MerchantOrderListView.description: A page of the merchant’s orders.

MerchantOrderView.description: A P2P order as its merchant sees it: the payer’s identity on a live purchase or charge (check the transfer comes from that person), the beneficiary’s account on a live sale or payout (where to pay). Nothing about the client that created it.

chat.description: The order’s chat with the side that created it (`/v1/p2p/merchant/orders/{id}/messages`).

merchantSide.description: The merchant’s side: seller on purchases and charges (it releases), buyer on sales, QR payments and payouts (it accepts and pays).

qr.description: A live QR payment’s QR: what the merchant pays. Null otherwise.

settleDeadline.description: When the settle window of a paid order closes: after it anyone may release the order, and the seller’s side can no longer dispute it. Null without a settle window, or before the order is paid.

MerchantQrView.description: A QR payment’s scanned QR, for its merchant while the order is live: draw the QR from `payload` and pay it with your banking app, then mark the order paid.

payload.description: The exact text scanned (EMV), CRC included.

MerchantStatsView.description: A merchant's track record, as quotes show it.

cancelledOrders.description: Orders it had to act on and did not (a sale it never accepted or paid, an order it cancelled).

completionRate.description: completed / (completed + cancelled); 0.5 for a merchant with no history yet.

disputesLost.description: Disputes an arbiter resolved against it.

medianReleaseSeconds.description: Median seconds from paid to released, over its recent orders.

NetworkView.description: One Stellar network the P2P market runs on: where the contract is, and what it trades.

contract.description: The P2P market contract (C...): where balances are deposited and orders lock tokens. Verified against this service's build (its wasm hash) before it is listed.

explorerUrl.description: A stellar.expert-style explorer: append `/tx/<hash>`, `/account/<G...>` or `/contract/<C...>`. Null when there is none.

horizonUrl.description: A public Horizon endpoint, or null.

networkPassphrase.description: Its network passphrase: what transactions are signed for.

paused.description: Whether the contract is paused: no new deposits, orders or acceptances, while every withdrawal, release, cancellation and dispute still works.

protocolFeeBps.description: The protocol fee, basis points of every payment to a buyer, as the contract charges it now. Each order keeps the rate it was opened with.

rpcUrl.description: A PUBLIC Soroban RPC endpoint; never the node this service reads through.

OfferView.description: A merchant's standing price on one network, token, currency and side. A price older than `priceTtlSeconds` is not matched until it is refreshed.

priceFresh.description: Whether the price is still within its lifetime, so the offer can be matched.

side.description: SELL_TOKEN: the merchant sells tokens (people buy them). BUY_TOKEN: the merchant buys tokens (people sell them, clients pay out).

OrderChatSummary.description: An order’s chat at a glance (an unread badge reads it): how many messages, when the last one came and from which side.

OrderMerchantView.description: The merchant of an order, as its client sees it.

OrderMessageAttachment.description: A message’s file, its bytes in base64.

data.description: The file, base64 (at most 2097152 bytes decoded).

OrderMessageAttachmentMeta.description: A message’s file, without its bytes.

OrderMessageList.description: An order’s latest messages (200 at most), oldest first.

OrderMessageView.description: One message of an order’s chat, between the side that created the order (`creator`) and its merchant (`merchant`). A message with an attachment is a transfer receipt (`kind: receipt`); fetch its bytes from `…/messages/{messageId}/attachment`.

OrderSettlementView.description: What an order paid out when it ended, base units.

bondToSeller.description: Of the buyer’s bond, to the seller (a resolution only).

toBuyer.description: To the buyer of the tokens, after fees.

OrderTxHashesView.description: The transactions an order went through, by step.

OrderView.description: A P2P order as the organization that created it sees it. `status` moves only on what the chain shows: `pending` (the opening transaction is not indexed yet, or a sale waits for the seller’s signature), `awaiting_acceptance`, `awaiting_payment`, `paid`, `disputed`, then `completed`, `cancelled`, `expired` (cancelled after a deadline), `resolved` (by the arbiter) or `failed` (never opened).

bond.description: The merchant’s bond, base units (sales and payouts).

chat.description: The order’s chat with its merchant (`…/orders/{id}/messages`).

fiatAmount.description: The local money that changes hands.

kind.description: BUY: a person buys tokens from a merchant. SELL: a person sells tokens to a merchant. QR_PAY: a person pays a shop’s local-money QR through a merchant that buys their tokens. CHARGE: a payer pays one of your charges. PAYOUT: a merchant pays a beneficiary from your balance.

netAmount.description: Base units its buyer receives after fees.

onchainId.description: The order id in the contract, once indexed.

paidReference.description: The transfer reference reported with the payment.

paymentDetails.description: Where the person pays the local money: the merchant’s account, on a purchase or a charge while it is live. Null otherwise.

qr.description: A QR payment’s scanned QR, as its payer reads it (one order, not lists).

settleDeadline.description: When the settle window of a paid order closes: after it anyone may release the order, and the seller’s side can no longer dispute it. Null without a settle window, or before the order is paid.

OrderWindowsView.description: Seconds each step of the order will have.

acceptWindow.description: To accept (orders with a bond only).

paymentWindow.description: To pay the local money and report it.

settleWindow.description: After a reported payment with no dispute, before anyone may release it; 0 = never on its own.

Organization.description: A tenant: a business, a merchant, or both.

Sign the envelope as it is and submit it with `POST /v1/app/submit` or `POST /v1/p2p/submit` (the sponsor pays the fee), or submit it yourself. This service never signs it.

action.description: What it does: a market function (`deposit`, `open_with_deposit`, `release`...), `transfer` (a token payment) or `activate`.

description.description: What signing it does, in one line, for a confirmation screen.
description.example: Release order 7: pays its buyer 98.5 USDC

expiresAt.description: Its upper time bound: sign and submit it before then.

hash.description: The hex hash of the transaction (the inner one when it is fee-bumped).

PayCharge.description: Pay a charge with tokens from your balance.

PayerDto.description: Who pays the local money on a purchase: the merchant checks the transfer comes from this person.

PayerView.description: Who says they paid: shown to the merchant of a live purchase or charge.

PaymentDetailsView.description: The merchant's account to pay, shown to the client of a live purchase or charge only.

holderName.description: The holder the transfer goes to.

PaymentMethodView.description: Where an account receives local money on one rail. Shown in full to its owner, and to the counterparty of a live order only.

active.description: Inactive methods are never shown on an order.

details.description: The rail’s fields, normalized (`GET /v1/p2p/market` lists them per rail).

holderName.description: The account holder, as the bank shows it.

PayoutBatchListView.description: A page of payout batches (their orders left out).

PayoutBatchView.description: A payout batch: one order per item a merchant took, and the items none could take.

orders.description: Empty in a list; the batch read carries them.

status.description: processing while any order is live; then completed (every order completed), partially_completed or failed (none did).

PayoutItemDto.description: One payout: an amount of local money to a beneficiary on one rail.

fiatAmount.description: What the beneficiary receives, local money.

QrSummaryView.description: What a QR payment’s scanned QR reads, for the person who scanned it (never the payload itself).

amount.description: The amount a dynamic QR asks for; null for a static one.

QuoteMerchantView.description: The merchant a quote matched, as people see it: a name and a track record, never its address or accounts.

cancelledOrders.description: Orders it had to act on and did not (a sale it never accepted or paid, an order it cancelled).

completionRate.description: completed / (completed + cancelled); 0.5 for a merchant with no history yet.

disputesLost.description: Disputes an arbiter resolved against it.

medianReleaseSeconds.description: Median seconds from paid to released, over its recent orders.

bond.description: SELL: the merchant’s bond, base units, locked when it accepts. 0 on a BUY.

fiatAmount.description: BUY: what the person pays. SELL: what the person receives.

integratorFee.description: Base units, paid to your registered wallet.

kind.description: The order kind the quote is for: its side, or `QR_PAY` for a scanned QR.

netAmount.description: Base units the buyer of the tokens receives after fees: the person on a BUY, the merchant on a SELL.

qr.description: A QR payment’s scanned QR (merchant, city, amount); null otherwise.

side.description: The person’s side: BUY receives tokens for local money, SELL sends tokens for it (a QR payment is a SELL).

options.description: The values it takes, when it is a choice.

required.description: Whether a merchant’s payment method (`/v1/p2p/payment-methods`) must give it.

RailView.description: A local payment rail and the details it needs.

displayName.description: The name people see on quotes when this account is a merchant.

transaction.description: The challenge from `POST /v1/p2p/accounts/challenge`, signed (base64 XDR). It names the account, your organization and tier.

ReportPaidDto.description: The payment report: the transfer’s reference, when there is one.

token.description: Shown once (SEP-10’s `token`). Browsers use the HttpOnly cookie set with it; other clients send it as `Authorization: Bearer`.

transaction.description: The challenge transaction, signed by the account’s signers, base64 XDR.

SponsorView.description: Whether the API pays network fees and reserves for wallets.

enabled.description: True: `POST /v1/app/submit` and `/v1/p2p/submit` fee-bump signed transactions with the sponsor account, and activations are sponsored. False: transactions are submitted as signed (the wallet pays its fee).

ledger.description: The ledger it was applied in.

sponsored.description: Whether the sponsor paid its fee.

xdr.description: The signed inner `TransactionEnvelope` (base64 XDR), exactly as built by this API and signed. Never a fee-bump.

info.description:
A peer-to-peer market for stablecoins against local money.

Credentials:
- **API keys** (`Authorization: Bearer pk_live_...` / `pk_test_...`) act for one organization on one tier; scopes `p2p:read`, `p2p:write`.
- **Wallet sessions** (Sign-In with Ethereum, `/v1/auth/*`): an HttpOnly cookie for browsers, or `Authorization: Bearer ps_sess_...`. Members act for an organization with the `Midpoint-Organization` and `Midpoint-Tier` headers.
- The market overview, sign-in and the hosted charge's payer routes (`/v1/p2p-checkout/*`) take no credentials.

Every error is `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details"? } }`.

Webhooks are signed: `midpoint-signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<t>.<body>")>`.
